cohort: Women who reported tubal sterilization failure to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Government Medical College Thiruvananthapuram between January 2012 and December 2016.
finding: Out of 362 sterilization failures, 307 (84.8%) were ectopic pregnancies and 55 (15.2%) were intrauterine pregnancies; of the ectopic pregnancies, 50.48% were ruptured.
